note: How a party travels as one (docs/45-party-travel.md). A leader's world-map travel in an outpost starts a countdown, and the whole party moves when it ends; any member crossing a doorway moves the whole party at once. Read once when the world starts: restart the world after changing it. Experimental.

countdown_secs.doc: Seconds between a leader's world-map travel and the party's move. Members who travel elsewhere during it leave the party. The client is shown the number in 0x01BC.

countdown_byte.doc: The mode byte after the u32 seconds in 0x01BC. The live countdown sends 1 (recordings/client/feature/multiplay/multiplay-live-20261106-231251.jsonl seq 110); 0 is the cancel-side value.

countdown_text.doc: The text 0x01BC carries (up to 122 UTF-16 units). The live countdown sends an empty string: the destination is not in this message.

arrival_grace_secs.doc: Seconds a member told to travel with its party has to arrive in the destination before the party drops it from the member list.

disconnect_hold_secs.doc: Seconds a party in an explorable keeps the place of a member whose connection dropped: 15 minutes, the game's rule (docs/36-game-rules-ledger.md, R11). A clean logout is a leave and is not held.

resign_secs.doc: Seconds between a member's /resign chat line and its death. The live capture recorded 11.334 s for the line and 16.888 s for the deaths, 5.55 s later (recordings/client/feature/multiplay/multiplay-live-20261106-200638.jsonl).
